name: Havard agave
desc: Havard agave (Agave havardiana): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 66 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Agave havardiana is a plant species native to the Big Bend area of western Texas as well as Chihuahua and Coahuila. It prefers grassy to rocky slopes or woodlands at elevations of 1200–2000 m.
